extracted.name: Tahini, feta & honey toastie
extracted.description: Indulge in a melty feta toastie, with nutty tahini and a drizzle of honey. This is irresistible quick comfort food you can make in just ten minutes
ingredient_lines: 2 slices of bread sourdough works well for toasting
instruction_lines: Mix the tahini and honey together. Spread the mixture on a slice of bread (sourdough works well for toasting). Scatter over the feta and a few thyme leaves, then top with another slice of bread. Butter the outsides and press sesame seeds into each side. Fry in a hot pan, weighed down by another pan, for 2 mins on each side (or use a toasted sandwich maker), then drizzle with honey.
